answer: Each identity claims one pearl plot, names its price, and pays 5% Harberger tax into the vault each epoch. Anyone may buy the plot at that price: low loses the plot, high bleeds tax, and plots above the summit median pay double. First plot 40, k-th 40+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes owe 2,537,500 plus 5% tax per plot per epoch against a 40,000 pool. Rented-plot rings fail: one key holds one plot. Honest agents hold one fair plot and pay one plot's tax.
